name: AreaChart
description: An area chart: the line chart with its wash (and `stacked` for parts of a total).

props.name: area
props.description: The Sparkline wash under each line. Defaults on for a single series.

props.name: domain
props.description: Fixed value range (percentages: [0, 100]). Defaults to the data, rounded to nice ticks.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: One factual line for the empty state (R2.5): "No samples in the last hour".

props.name: errorText
props.description: What failed and what to do (R2.4): "Agent offline — retry when NST-C106 reconnects".

props.name: format
props.description: Full control of the number (the unit is still appended). Receives the chart's resolved locale as its second argument.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Format a numeric x.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name: what is plotted, for what, over when ("CPU · NST-C106 · last hour").

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP 47 locale for this chart's numbers, dates and table. Default: the nearest
`LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: markers
props.description: Events on the x axis.

props.name: now
props.description: "Now" for relative times in the readout. Defaults to the clock.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called with no arguments when the person presses Retry in the error state. The button appears only when this is set, `state` is "error" and the tier is not micro.

props.name: series
props.description: Chart series with stable identifiers, labels and typed values.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack the series as bands (parts of a total). Implies area.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled view state, including loading, empty and error states.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Status bands. With one series, the line itself takes the tone above each threshold.

props.name: title
props.description: A visible label in Metric's label role. Omit inside a panel whose header already names it.

props.name: unit
props.description: "%", "GB", "ms", or a counted noun ({ one, other })… "%" sticks to the number; other units take a space.

props.name: x
props.description: Shared x values, ascending: Dates for time series, numbers otherwise.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Label for x in the table and readout ("Time", "Sample").

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
